create_lama_uhn_dataset: run the script to create LAMA-UHN by filtering easy-to-guess questions from a LAMA dataset directory
run_string_match_filter: run the StringMatchFilter to remove queries where the object label is a substring of the subject label
run_person_name_filter: run the PersonNameFilter using BERT masked language modeling to filter queries where the object is a top-k guess for the subject name
review_LAMAUHNFilter_class: review the LAMAUHNFilter base class and its filter method that removes matching queries from a list
refactor_PersonNameFilter_get_top_k: refactor the PersonNameFilter get_top_k_for_name method to use a different BERT model or template
